description: MetaTrader 5 via the MetaTrader5 Python bridge and a local SQLite mirror. Not an HTTP API: live tools call the terminal through a Python subprocess; mirror tools read local SQLite.

auth.detail: Login is performed out-of-band via 'mt5-pp-cli connect login --password-env MT5_PASSWORD' or a named profile in config.toml. The MCP server never reads or stores passwords.

tools.name: mt5_doctor
tools.description: Run a preflight check: Python, MetaTrader5 package, terminal, login, store writability, safety mode. Non-zero exit means something blocks live commands; the detail field carries remediation.

tools.name: mt5_account_info
tools.description: Print account balance, equity, margin, leverage, currency, trade mode. Useful to confirm which broker account the CLI will operate against and whether it is real or demo.

tools.name: mt5_terminal_info
tools.description: Print MT5 terminal build, data path, and connected/trade-allowed flags.

tools.name: mt5_symbols_list
tools.description: List symbols from the local mirror, optionally filtered by a comma-separated glob (e.g. 'EUR*,XAU*'). Requires a prior 'mt5_sync_all' call.

tools.name: mt5_quote
tools.description: Get a live bid/ask/spread/last-tick quote for a symbol. Hits the bridge (~50ms) and does not require sync.

tools.name: mt5_positions_list
tools.description: Snapshot currently open positions. Live, not from the mirror.

tools.name: mt5_orders_list
tools.description: Snapshot pending orders. Live, not from the mirror.

tools.name: mt5_history_deals
tools.description: Read historical deals from the local mirror over a window. Requires a prior sync over the same window.

tools.name: mt5_risk_preview
tools.description: Project margin and ±pip P&L for a hypothetical position. Read-only, hits the bridge for live price.

tools.name: mt5_stats_summary
tools.description: Compute win rate, profit factor, expectancy, max drawdown, Sharpe & Sortino from the mirror's deals table over --since.

tools.name: mt5_sql
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the local mirror. Tables: accounts, symbols, ticks, bars_M1..MN1, orders, history_orders, positions, deals, calendar_events, features, backtests, audit. INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE are blocked — this tool is read-only by design.

tools.name: mt5_sync_all
tools.description: Mirror MT5 data into the local SQLite store: symbols, positions, orders, history deals/orders. Optional bars and ticks. First sync over a wide window can take minutes; subsequent runs are incremental.

tools.name: mt5_order_check
tools.description: Preflight an order without sending it. Returns broker's predicted margin, fees, retcode (10009 = would succeed). Read-only, no safety gate.

tools.name: mt5_order_send
tools.description: Send a market order through the full safety pipeline: first call returns a SHA-256 intent hash (dry-run); re-call with confirm to execute. Live accounts additionally require MT5_LIVE=1 and the explicit live flag.

tools.name: mt5_close_all
tools.description: Bulk-close all open positions matching a SQL predicate. Dry-run + hash-confirm flow identical to the CLI's hero command.

tools.name: mt5_backtest_run
tools.description: Run a built-in strategy against historical bars from the local mirror. v1 ships 'sma-cross' (long-only SMA crossover with --fast/--slow). Persists the run row to the backtests table.

tools.name: mt5_backtest_list
tools.description: List prior backtest runs stored in the local mirror.

tools.name: mt5_audit_tail
tools.description: Show the most recent N entries from the append-only write audit log. Covers every dry-run, confirmed write, and rejection.
